facts.value: This is a wide-ranging and flexible degree. In first year, students select four subjects from a total of seventeen on offer. From second year onwards, students select two subjects to continue with for the remainder of their degree.

Bachelor of Arts at UL stands out because it offers unique subject combinations, a built-in work placement (cooperative education) and a mandatory semester of study abroad at one of UL’s partner institutions overseas.
Communication skills to express ideas effectively and persuasively.
Understanding of the forces that shape people, society, culture, communication and the physical world.
Studying an arts degree opens up a broad world of career possibilities in fields such as the public sector, teaching, communications, or politics.
Students select four subjects from a total of seventeen on offer.
From second year onwards, students select two subjects to continue with for the remainder of their degree.
Students interested in Politics and International Relations or Sociology can choose to take either of those subjects on their own from year two onwards.
You will know that studying arts at UL might be a good fit for you if you care about the world around you and want to understand the forces that shape society.
